messages:
sophie_sales: Quick heads-up 12Bank wants a POC but insists on strict EU data residency (no US subprocessors), BYO-KMS, and tenant-level routing pin. Sales needs a single artifact bundle for legal: 1) list of EU regions we can pin to, 2) current in-EU subprocessors + attestation timeline, 3) example routing policy they can sign, and 4) POC price uplift. They want answers by Thu COB.

leo_sre: We can support eu-west-1, eu-central-1, eu-west-3 for pinning. Storage options: AWS EU S3 (eu-central-1) or GCS EU buckets (eu-west-3). Monitoring runs on a Datadog EU tenancy but vendor support may reach from non-EU IPs  we need attestations we'll request one. I'll add a small perf appendix (p99 latency and token throughput) for each region.

maya_se: BYO-KMS is supported on Dedicated and Private only. Flow: customer supplies KMS ARN + cross-account role; we wrap with envelope encryption and do not import key material. Note: enabling BYO-KMS will require compliance signoff (est. 7 biz days). I'll prepare a short runbook with sample curl and the IAM trust snippet.

rachid_presales: Pricing notes: geo-pin add-on +13% on top of POC commit. Strict no-global-fallback (full EU isolation) is +24% due to reserved capacity. For a 21-30 day POC we can offer a conditional waiver of the geo-pin fee if they convert to Dedicated within 90 days (requires Revenue Ops approval). I'll draft two quote variants.

attest_bot: ATT-334 created: Requested Datadog EU support access attestation and subprocessor addendum. ETA 4 business days. Link: https://intra.redwood/attest/ATT-334

fiona_security: Quick security note: if they require no non-EU human access to telemetry, we must route logs through their VPC or use Private deployment. That is a separate plan and adds lead time. Also confirm whether the customer accepts vendor staff access under NDA; if not, legal addendum required.

sophie_sales: Action list: @leo_sre finalize region/perf snippet, @maya_se publish BYO-KMS runbook + IAM sample, @rachid_presales produce two quotes (lenient vs strict) with conditional waiver language, @fiona_security/legal confirm addendum language & escalate ATT-334. Need all artifacts Thu COB.

leo_sre: Routing policy example to show them: ```{"primary_region_group":"EU","pin_tenant":true,"standby_within":"EU","global_fallback":false}```. Will attach perf numbers shortly.

maya_se: Runbook draft uploaded to shared drive; I'll paste the curl example in here after lunch.

rachid_presales: Draft quotes ready in my draft folder. Will share in-thread within 2 hours with exact uplift numbers and conditions.

attest_bot: ATT-334 updated: Datadog asked to confirm whether support engineers use EU-only consoles. Vendor response pending.

sophie_sales: Thanks team  please drop docs in-thread so I can package for legal. :thumbsup:
